json_agg.description: Consistently ranked among Australia's best. Features lightning-fast greens and some of the best bunkering in Australia. Home course of Peter Thomson.

json_agg.name: The Vintage
json_agg.description: Greg Norman designed championship course in the Hunter Valley wine country. Ranked #31 in Australian Top 100 (2024). Features water hazards, rugged bunkers, and lush green fairways winding through vineyards.

json_agg.name: Torquay
json_agg.description: Premium links-style course designed by Ogilvy Clayton at the start of the Great Ocean Road. Features wide couch fairways, undulating greens, and challenging fescue roughs with stunning ocean views. The 6th at 433 yards is stroke index 1. Exceptional conditioning year-round.

json_agg.name: Toukley
json_agg.description: Friendliest club on the Central Coast, opened 1971 on bushland jutting into Budgewoi Lake. Unique layout: front nine tree-flanked, back nine links-style open to wind. Home to magnificent eagle breeding site.

json_agg.name: Townsville Golf Club
json_agg.description: Premier North Queensland parkland course established 1924. Four tee configurations.

json_agg.name: Traralgon
json_agg.description: Traditional parkland course in central Gippsland. The long 7th par 5 at 532 yards is stroke index 1, with the 14th at 367 yards being stroke index 2. Features three par 5s on the front nine for scoring opportunities.

json_agg.name: Tura Beach
json_agg.description: Parkland course designed by Michael Wolveridge, opened 1982. Par 73 layout with six par 5s. Stunning coastal setting near Merimbula.

json_agg.name: Twin Creeks
json_agg.description: Graham Marsh designed championship course opened in 2006, ranked in Australia's Top 100. Home of the 2017-2019 NSW Open Championships. Features 86 bunkers covering 2.5 hectares of sand, Bent grass greens and Legends couch fairways.

json_agg.name: Twin Waters Golf Club
json_agg.description: Parkland course opened 1991. Public access Sunshine Coast course.

json_agg.name: Ulverstone Golf Club
json_agg.description: Parkland course on Tasmania

json_agg.name: Victor Harbor Golf Club
json_agg.description: Scenic parkland course on the Fleurieu Peninsula with coastal views.

json_agg.name: Wagga Wagga
json_agg.description: Premier parkland course in the Riverina. Par 72 layout with four par 5s and four par 3s. Well-maintained with excellent playing surfaces year-round.

json_agg.name: Wallaroo Golf Club
json_agg.description: Yorke Peninsula coastal parkland course established in 1907. Open guest policy.

json_agg.name: Wangaratta
json_agg.description: Gentle undulating par 69 course set on historic Waldara Homestead grounds (built 1886). The 12th at 423 yards is stroke index 1, with the 14th par 5 at 561 yards being stroke index 3. Features five par 3s making accuracy key. Excellent value at $25 for 18 holes.

json_agg.name: Wanneroo Golf Club
json_agg.description: Northern suburbs parkland course established in 1973. Open guest policy with well-maintained fairways and greens.

json_agg.name: Wantima Country Club
json_agg.description: Parkland course established 1969.

json_agg.name: Warringah
json_agg.description: Popular public parklands course established in 1935, 15 minutes from Sydney CBD and 5 minutes from Manly and Freshwater beaches. Par 70 layout providing a fair test for all standards of golfers.

json_agg.name: Warrnambool
json_agg.description: Premier Great Ocean Road course with excellent conditioning. The challenging 10th par 5 at 618 yards is stroke index 1, with the 11th at 439 yards being stroke index 2. Features three long par 5s on the back nine. Two tee options available.

json_agg.name: Warwick Golf Club
json_agg.description: Parkland course established 1905. One of Queensland's oldest courses.

json_agg.name: Wembley Golf Complex - Old Course
json_agg.description: Historic Perth public course established in 1932. Popular municipal course with two 18-hole layouts. Open to all players.

json_agg.name: Wembley Golf Complex - Tuart Course
json_agg.description: Companion course to the Old Course at Wembley Golf Complex. Established 1932, offering a shorter but still challenging layout for all handicaps.

json_agg.name: Wentworth Falls
json_agg.description: Semi-private parkland course in the Blue Mountains. Par 70 layout with five par 3s and two par 5s. Mountain views and native bushland setting.

json_agg.name: Western Australian Golf Club
json_agg.description: Historic Perth parkland course established in 1928. One of WA's leading private clubs featuring classic design and excellent conditioning.

json_agg.name: Whyalla Golf Club
json_agg.description: Upper Spencer Gulf parkland course established in 1933.

json_agg.name: Willunga Golf Club
json_agg.description: Parkland course in the Fleurieu Peninsula wine region south of Adelaide.

json_agg.name: Windaroo Lakes Golf Club
json_agg.description: Parkland course with open guest policy.

json_agg.name: Wollongong
json_agg.description: Historic links-style course designed by Ross Watson, opened in 1897. Par 70 layout featuring five par 3s and five par 5s. Ocean views and coastal breezes make this a challenging round.

json_agg.name: Wolston Park Golf Club
json_agg.description: Parkland course. Closed guest policy.

json_agg.name: Woodford Golf Club
json_agg.description: Parkland course with open guest policy.

json_agg.name: Woodlands
json_agg.description: Often called Melbourne's most underrated course. Known for pure bent grass greens, strategic bunkering, excellent one-shotters.

json_agg.name: Woolgoolga
json_agg.description: Parkland course at Safety Beach on the Mid North Coast. Par 67 layout with one par 5 and eight par 3s. Unique short course ideal for beginners and seniors. Open to visitors.

json_agg.name: Woolooware
json_agg.description: Public 18-hole parkland course opened in 1955 in the Sutherland Shire. Tranquil journey through tall gums, melaleucas and indigenous plants. Subtle mounding and bunkering provides character for all skill levels.

json_agg.name: Wynnum Golf Club
json_agg.description: Bayside parkland course established 1922. Open guest policy.

json_agg.name: Wyong
json_agg.description: Established 1923 on 65 acres of pristine Central Coast land. Par 71 layout featuring heavy bunkering, flat terrain with tree-lined fairways, water hazards, and easy walking. 15 minutes from M1 Pacific Motorway.

json_agg.name: Yamba
json_agg.description: Parkland course in coastal Yamba. Par 71 layout (67 from white tees) featuring four par 5s on the back nine. Tight fairways require accuracy off the tee.

json_agg.name: Yarra Yarra
json_agg.description: Melbourne Sandbelt course with distinct shift between intimate front nine and roomier back nine. Large, fast, undulating greens. Restored by Tom Doak in 2017.

json_agg.name: Lake Course
json_agg.description: Parkland style course at Yarrawonga Mulwala Golf Club Resort. The 6th at 381 yards is stroke index 1, with the challenging 17th at 366 yards being stroke index 3. Shorter but more strategic than the Murray course with tighter fairways.

json_agg.name: Murray Course
json_agg.description: Peter Thomson and Mike Wolveridge championship design opened November 1986. Part of Australia's largest 45-hole public golf facility. The demanding 16th par 5 at 521 yards is stroke index 1. Features towering river gums and sandy river flats with numerous water hazards.

json_agg.name: Valley Course
json_agg.description: Part of the stunning 27-hole Ross Watson designed complex in the Yarra Valley. The Valley Course combines with the Homestead and Nursery nines. Features Bent Grass greens and Legend Couch fairways. Redesigned touches by Michael Clayton in 2024. The 17th at 406 yards is stroke index 1.

json_agg.name: Yowani Country Club
json_agg.description: Established parkland course opened in 1954 on Northbourne Avenue, one of Canberra's main arterial roads. Popular club with strong membership and open guest policy. Features challenging layout with mature trees.
